about: GTA 5's first trailer (Rockstar Games, 'Trailer', November 2, 2011, rockstargames.com/videos/s6c5c8co) and GTA 6's first trailer (Rockstar Games, Trailer 1, posted December 4, 2023 ET) side by side, shot for shot: both open on a sunset, both put ROCKSTAR GAMES PRESENTS over the skyline, then a beach crowd, a vehicle tearing across the water, trouble with the cops, and a giant city sign (VINEWOOD, VICE). Trailer 1 drew over 90 million views in 24 hours (Guinness: 90,421,491; YouTube Blog: 93 million+). Trailer mode, 12 muted annotated excerpts. Delta.

lines.say: G T A six's first trailer mirrors G T A five's.
